Chapter 15: The Legacy of Faith—Passing On What Matters Most.
Every life leaves a mark, doesn’t it? Sometimes it’s bold and clear, and other times, it’s more subtle—almost invisible, but still there.
As The Valley of Vision comes to a close, it turns our eyes to the future. These final prayers are all about asking for the grace to leave behind something lasting—faith, love, and hope.
And really, who doesn’t want their life to matter? Not just for our own sake, but for those who come after us too.
Picture someone looking back over their life—thinking about the moments that taught them the most, the mistakes they made, and the people who shaped their journey. There’s this deep longing to pass on what matters most. It’s not about leaving behind stuff or a list of accomplishments. It’s about sharing wisdom, showing humility, and learning how to love well.
These prayers echo with gratitude for those who paved the way before us, and hope for everyone who’ll follow. They ask for the strength to finish strong, the courage to keep moving forward, and the grace to forgive—and be forgiven.
That’s the heart of legacy. It’s not about being perfect. It’s about staying faithful.
And maybe you’ve wondered if your life makes a difference. These prayers are a gentle reminder that every act of love, every encouraging word, every quiet prayer—it all matters more than you know.
The Valley of Vision invites us to live with intention, to be generous, and to keep our hope alive. That’s the kind of legacy worth passing on.
